summary: Frontend-only verification of the new public /embed/grid page for PayCraft embed. All 5 scenarios pass: valid key renders read-only attendance grid (112 rows for 2026-08), no sidebar/admin nav, no login redirect; day cells are non-interactive (no modal on click); dark theme still renders 112 rows and the visible shell background is dark (verified by screenshot); wrong key shows 'Access denied' via data-testid=embed-grid-error with no table and no login redirect; missing key shows 'Access key required' error with no table.

issues: document.body computed backgroundColor is rgb(246,248,251) (light) even in dark theme — dark styling appears to be applied on an inner wrapper element rather than <body>/<html>. Visually the shell IS dark (confirmed by screenshot), so this is a minor cleanliness note only — external iframes with a transparent background could see a light bleed if the wrapper isn't min-h-screen. Consider also toggling document.documentElement.className='dark' or setting body bg for theme=dark.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider applying dark theme at the <html>/<body> level (or ensuring wrapper has min-h-screen) so iframe hosts with transparent backgrounds don't show light bleed around edges.
Error card copy is concise and clear; consider adding an aria-live='polite' on the error region for embed accessibility.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing August 2026 attendance data (112 members).
context_for_next_testing_agent: EmbedGrid public route is fully functional. Observed values: header 'Attendance Grid · 2026-08', subtitle '112 members · read-only', 112 rows with data-testid embed-row-*, 4256 day cells, no dialog opens on cell click. Wrong-key error text: 'Access deniedThe embed key is invalid.' Missing-key error text: 'Access key requiredAdd ?key=… to embed this grid.' Dark theme visually dark (screenshot) though body computed bg is light — implementation likely wraps content in a dark div.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues to RCA. Feature works as specified.
